Collaborate with the team to test and improve products by developing moderately complex experiments and tests (including writing and executing protocols), analyze results, share recommendations, and contribute to reports based on engineering principles - 25%
Work with colleagues to generate work instructions, test methods, engineering drawings/prototypes, etc. To establish and characterize product and/or process specifications - 25%
Coordinate with cross-functional partners to create and update portions of design control documents including requirement specs and risk documents - 20%
Support and coordinate technician work by assigning R&D tasks, providing instruction on conducting tests, training technicians, and giving feedback - 15%
Work alongside procurement and engineering teams to identify, evaluate, and manage suppliers, including establishing tolerances and defining acceptance criteria - 10%

Bachelor's degree in engineering required (Biomedical Engineering strongly preferred)
1 Plus years of relevant work experience with a bachelor's degree, master's preferred
1-3 Years of experience required
Prior experience as an engineer in a medically regulated industry
Design verification and validation experience in the medical device industry
Basic understanding of SolidWorks CAD system
Exposure to failure mode analysis
PPK, MLTL, or any base-level knowledge of statistical tools or analysis
Test method validation
Design verification (plans & protocols), reporting, and testing
Data failure analysis on the design verification testing
Work with accelerated and real-time aging

Collaborate with the team to test and improve products by developing moderately complex experiments and tests (including writing and executing protocols), analyze results, share recommendations, and contribute to reports based on engineering principles - 25%
Work with colleagues to generate work instructions, test methods, engineering drawings/prototypes, etc. To establish and characterize product and/or process specifications - 25%
Coordinate with cross-functional partners to create and update portions of design control documents including requirement specs and risk documents - 20%
Support and coordinate technician work by assigning R&D tasks, providing instruction on conducting tests, training technicians, and giving feedback - 15%
Work alongside procurement and engineering teams to identify, evaluate, and manage suppliers, including establishing tolerances and defining acceptance criteria - 10%
cond_0324.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in engineering required (Biomedical Engineering strongly preferred)
1 Plus years of relevant work experience with a bachelor's degree, master's preferred
1-3 Years of experience required
Prior experience as an engineer in a medically regulated industry
Design verification and validation experience in the medical device industry
Basic understanding of SolidWorks CAD system
Exposure to failure mode analysis
PPK, MLTL, or any base-level knowledge of statistical tools or analysis
Test method validation
Design verification (plans & protocols), reporting, and testing
Data failure analysis on the design verification testing
Work with accelerated and real-time aging
cond_0324.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

Collaborate with the team to develop and execute moderately complex experiments and tests, including writing and executing protocols, analyzing results, and contributing to reports and recommendations based on engineering principles - 25%
Work with colleagues to generate work instructions, test methods, and engineering drawings/prototypes to help establish and characterize product and/or process specifications - 25%
Coordinate with cross-functional partners to create and update portions of design control documents, including requirement specs and risk documents - 20%
Support and coordinate technician work by assigning tasks, providing instruction on conducting tests, training technicians, and sharing feedback - 15%
Work alongside the team to identify, evaluate, and manage suppliers, including helping establish tolerances and define acceptance criteria - 10%
cond_0585.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in engineering (Biomedical Engineering strongly preferred)
1–3 Years of relevant engineering experience
Prior experience as an engineer in a medically regulated industry
Design verification and validation experience in the medical device industry
Design verification plans, protocols, reporting, and testing
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree
Basic understanding of SolidWorks CAD system
Exposure to failure mode analysis
PPK, MLTL, or base-level knowledge of statistical tools or analysis
Test method validation
Data failure analysis on design verification testing
Experience with accelerated and real-time aging
